gripper_generalization.description: Gripper domain policy learning and larger-instance generalization. Paper reports Gripper in Table 1 and large-instance coverage/effective width in Table 3.

avg_applicable_successors.description: Mean number of legal successors admitted by the policy across visited decision states.

avg_effective_width.description: Average search-width proxy induced by incomplete larger-instance coverage.

avg_plan_length_ratio.description: Mean solved-instance action-count ratio relative to the domain planner.

capacity_shift_coverage.description: Coverage on same-domain instances with held-out gripper capacities.

feature_pool.description: Diagnostic self-reported size of the candidate feature pool; not scored because it is method-reported.

hard_instance_coverage.description: Coverage on the larger half of each slice, catching policies tuned only to easier visible instances.

hit_constraints.description: Diagnostic self-reported constraint count; not scored because it is method-reported.

inner_iterations.description: Diagnostic self-reported inner-loop count; not scored because future methods may not expose it.

large_instance_coverage.description: Fraction of larger Gripper instances solved by the learned policy.

max_applicable_successors.description: Largest number of legal successors admitted by the policy at a visited decision state.

max_effective_width.description: Worst-case search-width proxy induced by unsolved larger instances.

max_plan_length_ratio.description: Worst solved-instance action-count ratio relative to the domain planner.

outer_iterations.description: Diagnostic self-reported outer-loop count; not scored because future methods may not expose it.

policy_quality.description: Held-out policy quality: solved-instance coverage minus a small penalty for admitting multiple legal successors at visited states.

policy_rules.description: Number of abstract policy rules in the emitted policy artifact.

selected_features.description: Number of selected symbolic features in the emitted policy artifact.

train_coverage.description: Coverage on the small learning instances, guarding against methods that abandon the original task.

gripper_generalization.notes: Paper-reported values are used for large_instance_coverage, train_coverage, effective width, selected_features, policy_rules, feature_pool, wrapper iterations, and hit_constraints. policy_quality is a derived gym index anchored at the paper's ideal Gripper result of 100% coverage with effective width 0, then penalized by evaluator-only branching. Other hard/capacity/branching metrics are defined so reproduced scores can be checked for robustness, but no reference values are assigned to them because they are not reported in the paper.
